# llms.txt — Skill Finder docs section

This file orients an LLM agent to the documentation resources at https://skills.mikedemo.dev/docs/api.

## What this section covers

- API endpoint reference with request/response shapes and the envelope format
- Error codes and rate-limit behavior
- MCP tool reference (search_skills, get_skill, list_agents)

## Key links

- [API docs](https://skills.mikedemo.dev/docs/api)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://skills.mikedemo.dev/openapi.json)
- [Capabilities endpoint](https://skills.mikedemo.dev/api/public/v1/capabilities)

## When to use this section

Use it when the agent needs endpoint-level detail beyond the overview in /llms.txt — parameter shapes, error codes, or the MCP tool schemas.
